opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in a UK institution; individuals without formal employment with host institution are not eligible; projects led by schools, undergraduates, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, and ongoing costs are not funded.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research addressing priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review, up to £500,000 per grant (up to £750,000 in special cases).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly racially minoritised communities; partnership applications welcomed; UK-based institutions.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on intergenerational changes and challenges; grants from £15k to £500k.
